# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /usr/bin/composer
# args: 
Description:
  Sets config options.

Usage:
  config [options] [--] [<setting-key> [<setting-value>...]]

Arguments:
  setting-key                    Setting key
  setting-value                  Setting value

Options:
  -g, --global                   Apply command to the global config file
  -e, --editor                   Open editor
  -a, --auth                     Affect auth config file (only used for --editor)
      --unset                    Unset the given setting-key
  -l, --list                     List configuration settings
  -f, --file=FILE                If you want to choose a different composer.json or config.json
      --absolute                 Returns absolute paths when fetching *-dir config values instead of relative
  -j, --json                     JSON decode the setting value, to be used with extra.* keys
  -m, --merge                    Merge the setting value with the current value, to be used with extra.* keys in combination with --json
      --append                   When adding a repository, append it (lowest priority) to the existing ones instead of prepending it (highest priority)
      --source                   Display where the config value is loaded from
  -h, --help                     Display help for the given command. When no command is given display help for the list command
  -q, --quiet                    Do not output any message
  -V, --version                  Display this application version
      --ansi|--no-ansi           Force (or disable --no-ansi) ANSI output
  -n, --no-interaction           Do not ask any interactive question
      --profile                  Display timing and memory usage information
      --no-plugins               Whether to disable plugins.
      --no-scripts               Skips the execution of all scripts defined in composer.json file.
  -d, --working-dir=WORKING-DIR  If specified, use the given directory as working directory.
      --no-cache                 Prevent use of the cache
  -v|vv|vvv, --verbose           Increase the verbosity of messages: 1 for normal output, 2 for more verbose output and 3 for debug

Help:
  This command allows you to edit composer config settings and repositories
  in either the local composer.json file or the global config.json file.
  
  Additionally it lets you edit most properties in the local composer.json.
  
  To set a config setting:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config bin-dir bin/
  
  To read a config setting:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config bin-dir
      Outputs: bin
  
  To edit the global config.json file:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config --global
  
  To add a repository:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config repositories.foo vcs https://bar.com
  
  To remove a repository (repo is a short alias for repositories):
  
      /usr/bin/composer config --unset repo.foo
  
  To disable packagist:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config repo.packagist false
  
  You can alter repositories in the global config.json file by passing in the
  --global option.
  
  To add or edit suggested packages you can use:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config suggest.package reason for the suggestion
  
  To add or edit extra properties you can use:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config extra.property value
  
  Or to add a complex value you can use json with:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config extra.property --json '{"foo":true, "bar": []}'
  
  To edit the file in an external editor:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config --editor
  
  To choose your editor you can set the "EDITOR" env variable.
  
  To get a list of configuration values in the file:
  
      /usr/bin/composer config --list
  
  You can always pass more than one option. As an example, if you want to edit the
  global config.json file.
  
      /usr/bin/composer config --editor --global
  
  Read more at https://getcomposer.org/doc/03-cli.md#config
